name: list
note: since is optional (hex, at most 64); when it equals the current revision the answer is state-unchanged.json. Only the shared workspaces' agent panes are listed. A client polls every 1 s while one of the host's panes runs, waits for an answer or is looked at, otherwise every 5 s

name: detail
note: read only for panes the client shows or that wait for an answer, and only when the list's revision for the pane moved; 404 for a pane outside the shared workspaces

name: submit
note: the phone's send: started, steered or queued; 403 remote.host.error.fullAccessOff for a full-access pane while the host's switch is off; body up to 12 MiB for attachments

name: permission
note: always: true needs the host's full-access switch (403 remote.host.error.antigravityAlways)

name: create
note: agent panes only; the workspace's worktree mode decides without asking; 403 for a workspace not shared
